description: Implementation of the RendererImpl class for media rendering, including initialization, track management, buffering, and error handling in a media pipeline.

classes.name: RendererImpl::RendererClientInternal
classes.description: Internal class implementing RendererClient interface to handle callbacks for specific stream types (audio/video) and forwarding them to RendererImpl.

methods.name: RendererImpl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with media resources and client, handling encrypted streams and starting audio renderer setup.

methods.name: RendererImpl::SetCdm
methods.description: Sets the Content Decryption Module (CDM) context for encrypted media streams.

methods.name: RendererImpl::SetLatencyHint
methods.description: Sets latency preferences for video and audio renderers.

methods.name: RendererImpl::SetPreservesPitch
methods.description: Configures whether pitch is preserved during playback rate changes.

methods.name: RendererImpl::SetWasPlayedWithUserActivation
methods.description: Indicates if playback was initiated with user activation.

methods.name: RendererImpl::Flush
methods.description: Flushes current media buffers and resets renderer state.

methods.name: RendererImpl::StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from a specified media time.

methods.name: RendererImpl::SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Adjusts the playback speed.

methods.name: RendererImpl::SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the audio volume.

methods.name: RendererImpl::GetMediaTime
methods.description: Returns the current media playback time.

methods.name: RendererImpl::DisableUnderflowForTesting
methods.description: Disables underflow detection for testing purposes.

methods.name: RendererImpl::EnableClocklessVideoPlaybackForTesting
methods.description: Enables clockless video playback mode for testing.

methods.name: RendererImpl::GetWallClockTimes
methods.description: Retrieves wall clock times for given media timestamps, with special handling for testing mode.

methods.name: RendererImpl::HasEncryptedStream
methods.description: Checks if any media stream is encrypted.

methods.name: RendererImpl::FinishInitialization
methods.description: Completes initialization and reports status.

methods.name: RendererImpl::FinishFlush
methods.description: Completes flush operation.

methods.name: RendererImpl::InitializeAudioRenderer
methods.description: Sets up the audio renderer with the first available audio stream.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnAudioRendererInitializeDone
methods.description: Callback after audio renderer initialization, proceeds to video renderer setup if successful.

methods.name: RendererImpl::InitializeVideoRenderer
methods.description: Sets up the video renderer with the first available video stream.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnVideoRendererInitializeDone
methods.description: Callback after video renderer initialization, finalizes setup.

methods.name: RendererImpl::FlushInternal
methods.description: Performs internal flush of audio and video renderers.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnAudioRendererFlushDone
methods.description: Callback after audio renderer flush completes, proceeds to video flush.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnVideoRendererFlushDone
methods.description: Callback after video renderer flush completes, finalizes flush process.

methods.name: RendererImpl::ReinitializeAudioRenderer
methods.description: Reinitializes the audio renderer with a new stream.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnAudioRendererReinitialized
methods.description: Callback after reinitializing audio renderer, may restart or handle errors.

methods.name: RendererImpl::ReinitializeVideoRenderer
methods.description: Reinitializes the video renderer with a new stream.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnVideoRendererReinitialized
methods.description: Callback after reinitializing video renderer, may restart or handle errors.

methods.name: RendererImpl::RestartAudioRenderer
methods.description: Restarts the audio renderer with a new stream and media time.

methods.name: RendererImpl::RestartVideoRenderer
methods.description: Restarts the video renderer with a new stream and media time.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnStatisticsUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to media pipeline statistics.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnBufferingStateChange
methods.description: Handles buffering state changes for streams, including deferrals and underflow management.

methods.name: RendererImpl::WaitingForEnoughData
methods.description: Checks if renderer is waiting for enough data to continue playback.

methods.name: RendererImpl::PausePlayback
methods.description: Pauses media playback and stops the clock.

methods.name: RendererImpl::StartPlayback
methods.description: Resumes media playback and starts the clock.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnRendererEnded
methods.description: Handles end of stream events for audio/video.

methods.name: RendererImpl::PlaybackHasEnded
methods.description: Checks if all streams have ended.

methods.name: RendererImpl::RunEndedCallbackIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers end-of-playback callback if all streams ended.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnFallback
methods.description: Handles fallback events in media pipeline.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnError
methods.description: Handles errors in media pipeline, transitions to error state.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnWaiting
methods.description: Handles waiting events, forwards to client.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnAudioConfigChange
methods.description: Handles audio configuration changes.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnVideoConfigChange
methods.description: Handles video configuration changes.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnVideoNaturalSizeChange
methods.description: Handles changes in video natural size.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnVideoOpacityChange
methods.description: Handles changes in video opacity.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnVideoFrameRateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in video frame rate.

methods.name: RendererImpl::CleanUpTrackChange
methods.description: Finalizes track change operations, resets states.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnSelectedVideoTracksChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in selected video tracks, reinitializing or restarting renderer.

methods.name: RendererImpl::OnEnabledAudioTracksChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in enabled audio tracks, reinitializing or restarting renderer.

methods.name: RendererImpl::GetRendererType
methods.description: Returns the type of renderer.
